raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Followup of #43596. The hybrid Mamba stacks built the controller routing from `req_to_token_pool.mamba_map` while the Mamba host pool was built from the pool's `DevicePoolInfo`, so routing and host layout came from two separate sources. The assembler now captures the info once and derives both from its `layer_ids`. The packed draft offset uses the same axis instead of `num_mamba_layers`.

The direct linker still reads `mamba_map` and will move with the linker migration.

## Accuracy

Cache hits are forced to come back from host and checked through `cached_tokens_details`.

`test_unified_radix_cache_kl_hybrid_bitexact.py` (Inkling, FULL + SWA + Mamba, deterministic):

```
                                     main            this PR
avg_kl_div (L2 host)                 0.0             0.0
  cached tokens device / host        10496 / 15104   10496 / 15104
avg_kl_div (L3 storage)              0.0             0.0
  cached tokens storage              4096            4096
```

Hybrid FULL + Mamba stacks, decode logprob vs prefill replay on the same server. The assembled host pools and the host to device transfer sequence are identical to main in both runs:

```
model                             host hits (prefill, decode)   KL prefill hit       KL decode hit
                                  main / PR                     main / PR            main / PR
Qwen3.8-27B, NEXTN                5/8 8/8 / same                2.60e-4 / 2.65e-4    1.115e-4 / same
Qwen3.8-Flash-Next tp4, NEXTN     5/8 8/8 / same                1.17e-2 / 5.29e-3    3.577e-3 / same
```

GSM8K, Inkling tp4, sgl-eval, all 1319 questions:

```
main:     0.9606
this PR:  0.9606  (every output identical to main)
```

The tested models put only attention layers in the MTP draft, so the packed draft Mamba offset is covered by `test_hybrid_pool_assembler.py` and `test_mtp_hicache.py` rather than by a model run.
